# Recall

> Recall is a local repo-memory compiler for coding agents. It learns durable rules from your corrections, review feedback, repo scans, and session outcomes, then re-injects them into every session through CLI, MCP, daemon endpoints, and lifecycle hooks.

## What is Recall?

Recall (recallmemory.dev) fixes the loop where you correct your coding agent, it forgets, and you correct it again. Recall captures the durable rule hidden in a correction once, stores it locally, and injects a compact trusted instruction set at the start of every session.

Local-first. No cloud and no API keys required for the common path. Recall Cloud is an optional hosted layer for sync, search, and team access.

- Website: https://recallmemory.dev/
- Source: https://github.com/edihasaj/recall
- Recall Cloud: https://app.recallmemory.dev/
- Releases: https://github.com/edihasaj/recall/releases
- Support: support@recallmemory.dev

## How it works

```bash
recall correct -r owner/repo "don't use npm, use pnpm"
# next session start:
# the SessionStart hook injects: "- use pnpm as the package manager"
```

Capture sources: explicit corrections, code review feedback, repository scans, and session outcomes. Retrieval is hybrid (lexical plus vector), quality-gated, and scoped per repository with a global tier for rules that apply everywhere.

## Interfaces

- CLI: `recall correct`, `recall query`, `recall setup`, `recall doctor`, `recall scan`
- MCP server: `capture_correction`, `query`, `confirm`, `reject`, and the rest of the memory tools for any MCP-capable agent
- Lifecycle hooks: SessionStart injection and per-prompt capture for Claude Code, Codex, opencode, and other agents
- Daemon endpoints for editors and custom integrations
- Web dashboard: memories, knowledge graph (2D and 3D), event timeline, and live sessions

## Benchmarks

LongMemEval-S, N=500 non-abstention, the same dataset agentmemory publishes.

| System | R@5 | R@10 | R@20 | NDCG@10 | MRR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| agentmemory BM25 + vector | 95.2% | 98.6% | 99.4% | 87.9 | 88.2 |
| Recall, same model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) | 96.6% | 97.6% | 99.8% | 87.0 | 86.8 |
| Recall shipped (multilingual-e5-small) | 97.4% | 99.4% | 99.6% | 90.1 | 89.5 |

Full methodology: https://github.com/edihasaj/recall/blob/main/benchmark/COMPARISON.md

## Install

```bash
brew install --cask edihasaj/tap/recall
recall setup --yes
recall doctor
```

Or: `curl -fsSL https://recallmemory.dev/install.sh | bash`

macOS ships a menu bar app; Linux and Windows builds are available from the releases page.
